lede: The biggest thing on the boards this week is a public hearing at the San Miguel County BOCC on whether to waive land use fees for Mountain Village's Ilium Valley affordable housing project — a real signal of how much the county is willing to put behind housing, not just talk about it. Telluride Town Council also holds a public hearing Tuesday on a vesting period extension and takes up the Flock Safety license plate reader system in a morning work session. Meanwhile, both Mountain Village and the county are deep in 2027 budget season, and the San Miguel County Planning Commission spends Thursday in a joint session with the BOCC on an affordable housing code update.

notable.stake: Public hearing on vesting extension; ALPR camera system up for scrutiny.
Public hearing on fee waivers for Ilium Valley affordable housing project.
